title: Name the source-change reason when native credit is withheld because the full source_id changed between S0 and after
outcome: Name the source-change reason when native credit is withheld because the full source_id changed between S0 and after
acceptance: When a native declared run's full source_id after the run differs from S0, the withheld record and the host's turn notice name that reason specifically (source changed during the run) and list what changed, per the w-e072 criterion: an edited tracked file, a new non-ignored untracked file, or a changed submodule HEAD, with the changed paths. This is reported separately from a reservation or terminal mismatch.
Withholding behaviour is unchanged: no credit when S0 differs from after, and credit when they are equal. No new condition; the change is the reason text and structure only.
A behavioural test drives a run whose source changes mid-run, for each of the three change kinds, and asserts the named reason and paths; no text-pin of unrelated wording.

completion.summary: Delivered named source-change diagnostics separately from native reservation mismatches, with complete retained entries and bounded turn notices; landed fdbb53c8 and confirmed live after restart.
